title: USPS Operational 5-Digit ZIP Assignment Evidence
description: Current USPS-published Area/District 5-digit ZIP assignments reconciled against the broader AISU routing file.

coverage_semantics.included: ZIP appears in the current USPS AREADIST_ZIP5 Area/District assignment file.
coverage_semantics.excluded: AISUZIPS-only routing rows are not counted as operational Area/District assignments.

publication: Local restricted by default; manifest aggregates may be reported, but record-level USPS and derived ZIP assignment rows are not committed or redistributed without reviewed written permission.
